actions.name: barbed hide
actions.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals [[/damage average]] damage to any creature [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=1O5eyc72vPW0UxYZ]].

actions.name: diabolical restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmClaws000000000]] attack and one [[/item .mmTail0000000000]] attack, or it makes two [[/item .mmHurlFlame00000]] attacks.

actions.name: claws
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from both claws.

actions.name: hurl flame
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.
